text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 624 December 26, 1974
AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY THREE HUNDRED AND FORTY-ONE AS
AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY FIVE HUNDRED AND NINETY CREATING
THE CATANDUANES STATE COLLEGE
WHEREAS, the Catanduanes State College, acting under and by authority of its Charter, Republic Act No.
6341, as amended by Republic Act No. 6590, has established secondary schools in the different municipalities
of the province of Catanduanes, and these schools now serve the educational needs of the local population;
WHEREAS, the authority to establish and maintain secondary schools under its present charter has been
questioned and a negation of its authority would result in the closure of these secondary schools and thus
cause great hardship and dislocation in the school program of the municipalities concerned; and
WHEREAS, it is humanely just and proper to avoid such closure and spare the residents of Catanduanes from
the arduous consequences of such event;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby decree the amendment of Section 1 of Republic Act No. 6341, as
amended by Republic Act No. 6590 by inserting an additional clause thereto to read as follows:
The various secondary schools that have been established and maintained by the Catanduanes State Colleges
as of the date of this decree are hereby reorganized and confirmed, and their continued maintenance by the
Catanduanes State Colleges is hereby authorized."
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
